purpose: Nonprivate scenario specifications, not machine-audited examples or observed outcomes

cases.name: review-only-no-deploy
events: Review the release configuration. Do not change files or deploy.
assertions: Mentioning deployment does not make deployment instructions conditionally relevant

cases.name: multi-skill-stage-change
events: Inspect the form's keyboard behavior and validation text.
Now implement the approved accessibility and validation fixes.
assertions: More than one conditional skill may apply
Stage transition creates a fresh routing decision
Earlier review-only scope does not authorize later edits without the second instruction

cases.name: false-friend-alternative-bundles
events: Explain a spring animation. Do not configure a Spring server.
assertions: Lexical overlap is not verified applicability
Either complete accepted instructional bundle earns set credit
Unioning incompatible alternatives does not earn exact-set credit

cases.name: hidden-explicit-disabled
events: Use the explicitly named enabled hidden review skill.
The disabled deployment skill remains unavailable.
assertions: Enabled hidden skill can enter through explicit trusted policy
Hidden skill is not automatically retrieved
Disabled skill remains absent from the catalog

cases.name: insufficient-information
assertions: Insufficient evidence is uncertain, not none
No fabricated action or context enters the request

cases.name: renamed-unseen-description
events: Evaluate the task with a new resolved skill name and its current description.
assertions: Resolved IDs are join keys, not learned output classes
Current description and content digest must match the frozen catalog

cases.name: restore-body-evidence
events: A prior session had loaded the required instructions.
Restore the session, then propose the first relevant action.
assertions: Historical loaded state is not current outgoing-body evidence
Required body must precede the action
Missing activation measurement stays missing rather than successful
